name: Vision Clipping
summary: Vision Clipping is a done-for-you clipping and content distribution agency. It turns long-form content into short-form clips and posts them every day across a network of TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook accounts that the client owns, run by its own team on dedicated devices, geo-targeted to the markets the client sells in, with click attribution on every post. A separate music offer places artists' songs into trending edit formats across pages Vision Clipping owns.
serves: Worldwide (brand offer); United Kingdom by default, other countries on request (music offer)

founders.name: Emrah Bayraktar
founders.note: Quoted by NPR, Forbes and Yahoo Finance on the clipping economy.

offers.name: Brand distribution
howItWorks: A channel is four accounts (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube) created and owned by the client.
Each channel posts 120 times a month; every post is checked by a manager before it goes out.
Accounts run on dedicated devices set up in the client's target region, so views land in the countries the client sells to.
Every post is a test of hook, format and call to action; winners are rolled out across all accounts.
The client gets a dashboard with click attribution and keeps every account and follower.

pricing.includes: 4 accounts, 120 posts a month, $400 one-time setup
16 accounts, 480 posts a month, $1,600 one-time setup

offers.guarantee: If the goal agreed on the strategy call is not hit within the first month, work continues free until the next billing cycle.

offers.name: Music content distribution
howItWorks: Vision Clipping cuts edits that carry the artist's song in trending formats: football, news and culture, ranked formats, meme and dance comps, military and fight edits, basketball, pop culture.
The edits go out across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube on a network of pages Vision Clipping owns and runs, linked to the song's sound so viewers can use it and find it on streaming.
Premium and Elite also build dedicated accounts the artist owns.

pricing.includes: 300 posts on Vision Clipping pages, 90 on the artist's own accounts, 3 accounts the artist owns
450 posts on Vision Clipping pages, 270 on the artist's own accounts, 9 accounts the artist owns

differentiators: Accounts are owned by the client, not rented from anonymous clippers.
One team runs everything: strategy, cutting, posting and reporting.
Geo-targeted distribution from devices in the client's market.
Attribution on every post, so clips are judged on traffic and sales, not views alone.
